messages.subject: New line / line wrap in title
parts:
Hi all,

Does anyone know how to do a line break in a plot title from the "theme title" component from the "Other" element group in Plot Builder?
I tried \n, but Deducer exports that to R as a double break  '\\n' so it results in the \n being printed in the title.

cheers,
Kieran
